setupSteps.title: Install Git
setupSteps.verifierLabel: Git responds with a version number

setupSteps.title: Install Node LTS
setupSteps.verifierLabel: Node responds with a version number

steps.title: Open Terminal
steps.verifierLabel: Terminal is open

steps.title: Check Git and Node
steps.body: Use Terminal. Any current Node LTS works.
steps.verifierLabel: Git and Node respond with version numbers

steps.title: Copy Nutcracker to this Mac
steps.command:
cd ~
if [ ! -d nutcracker/.git ]; then
git clone https://github.com/Blueturboguy07/nutcracker.git
fi
steps.verifierLabel: A nutcracker folder appears

steps.title: Open the Nutcracker folder
steps.verifierLabel: Your terminal prompt is inside the nutcracker folder

steps.title: Use the reviewed version
steps.verifierLabel: Git reports the reviewed commit

steps.title: Install dependencies
steps.verifierLabel: The install finishes without an error

steps.title: Start Nutcracker
steps.body: Keep Terminal open — Nutcracker runs from it, and closing the window stops it.
steps.verifierLabel: The terminal prints a localhost address

steps.title: Open Nutcracker
steps.body: If the terminal printed a different address, open that one instead.
steps.verifierLabel: Nutcracker loads in your browser

steps.title: Ask LinkedIn for your connections export
steps.body: On LinkedIn: Settings & Privacy → Data privacy → Get a copy of your data → Connections.
steps.verifierLabel: LinkedIn confirms the archive was requested

steps.title: Download the export
steps.body: LinkedIn emails the link, usually within ten minutes. Nutcracker reads the Connections.csv inside.
steps.verifierLabel: You have the export on this computer

steps.title: Import it into Nutcracker
steps.body: Back in Nutcracker, add your export where it asks for your LinkedIn connections.
steps.verifierLabel: Your connections appear in Nutcracker

steps.title: Get your first coffee-chat suggestions
steps.body: Adding your own AI key sharpens the intro drafts, but everything works without one.
steps.verifierLabel: Nutcracker suggests people to reach out to
